data.body: Janitor plan-review close-out (2026-09-02): live `next-batch equitable-snazzy-fruitfly` found 11 currently unblocked implementation leaves, including the documentation-overlap leaf deferred only for conflict avoidance. Each has at least one signed plan-review PASS. The final sweep newly certified `commonlaw-subsonic-quetzal`, `disloyal-bardy-chrysalis`, `ruby-gelatinous-bighorn`, `cloned-amoebalike-zebra`, and `indiscreet-abdicant-isopod`. Four leaves now show `stale-code` because files moved after certification; per maintainer direction, this objective requires one prior signed PASS and intentionally does not refresh for drift. Epic `equitable-snazzy-fruitfly` passed plan review with signed attestation at `035a50310268c767e6c3d7eca0d46e89a0b8f033`. The local gate reported build drift as advisory only; it did not affect the signed result.
